content: postgres:18 image breaking change (docker-library/postgres PR #1259): PGDATA moved to /var/lib/postgresql/MAJOR/docker (/var/lib/postgresql/18/docker) and declared VOLUME changed to /var/lib/postgresql. Mounting at legacy /var/lib/postgresql/data fails with runc mount error OR silently writes data to an auto-created anonymous volume while the named volume stays empty -> initdb runs every container recreation, 'data gone'. Fix: mount named volume at /var/lib/postgresql. Do NOT override PGDATA back (fights design, breaks pg_upgrade --link path). Warning signs: 'fixing permissions... creating subdirectories' initdb output on every up; orphaned anonymous volumes accumulating. docker compose down removes containers but Ctrl+C stop keeps them - reset semantics differ.
